subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boxes F, G, H, I, K, L, and O are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above G. Only one box is kept between F and G. Only three boxes are kept between F and K. K is kept at some place above G. O is kept immediately below K. L is kept at one of the places above I. H is not kept immediately above or below F.

Which box is kept at the lowermost position?
solution:
Seven boxes F, G, H, I, K, L, and O are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only three boxes are kept above G.
 
• Only one box is kept between F and G.
 
• Only three boxes are kept between F and K.
 
• K is kept at some place above G.
 
• O is kept immediately below K.
 
• L is kept at one of the places above I.
 
• H is not kept immediately above or below F.
